reviews.text: I've been going there for grooming, and the staff are so kind; my dog ​​loves going too!
That's good.
There have been comments about the smell for the past 8 years, but it still hasn't been fixed! Please take a lesson from Ps-san, Puppy-chan is adorable 😍 …

I visited this cat cafe because I was tired from sightseeing during a trip from out of town.

There was a strange smell even before I entered the room. The stench was terrible once I went inside. It was unsanitary, and some of the cats had runny noses. I wish they would take better care of the cats and improve the environment. 😭 I felt so sorry for them, and I regretted paying money for this quality.

Even after entering the store, the staff didn't greet me or even look at me. They were just chatting amongst themselves about their hosts and hobbies. I went to see a cat I was interested in from the website, but the staff's behavior completely ruined my desire to adopt one.

I think this is a place where people are looking for a special person to become their family, so I hope they won't take that chance away from the animals.

While the cuteness of the animals is important, the staff's attitude directly impacts whether or not I decide to adopt one, so I wanted to write this in the hope that they will improve.

I visited the store around 3:00 PM on August 27th because I saw a dog online that I was interested in and wanted to adopt it.

When I arrived, there was no greeting, just a quick glance, and they seemed to ignore me.
The store's phone rang, and the staff member looked at the number and said something like, "Ugh, the same number again," in annoyance. They also started gossiping about other customers' matters loud enough for me to hear.

They ignored me so much that it seemed like they couldn't even see me. While I was looking at the dog, they came right in front of me and started cleaning, acting as if they were trying to chase me away. I had gone there intending to adopt a dog, but I decided I didn't want to get one from this store, so I left.

I think they need more training. The staff consisted of two women.
They both had pigtails.

I had been thinking about getting a second pet for a while, and when I found this adorable one, I decided to buy it immediately. The affordable price, among other factors, made it easy to plan the process of welcoming it into our family without any pressure. Compared to other stores, I appreciated being able to confirm each necessary detail one by one.

Thank you very much for your continued patronage.

We look forward to serving you again.

We appreciate your continued support of Coo&RIKU.

It's a disgrace that this kind of practice still exists in 2026; it's pure and simple exploitation at the expense of animal welfare. I haven't been there myself, but for God's sake, wake up and shut down places like this.
The staff are all very kind and nice. Since there's a veterinary clinic inside, I also take my pets there for grooming and vaccinations. All the dogs and cats are adorable!
I've been to cat cafes several times. I'm always very satisfied because I can freely play with the cats, and there are so many of them! 🥹 …
I was glad you were so kind and helpful.
Mr. Takebayashi's explanations were very clear and easy to understand. Thank you very much.

As this was our first time welcoming a puppy, we had many anxieties, but thanks to Ms. Takebayashi, who was in charge of our case, we were able to welcome our family member with peace of mind.

She explained everything carefully, not only about the dog's personality and characteristics, but also about daily life after bringing him home, training, and even feeding. She was truly caring and attentive to our needs.

Thank you very much for your continued patronage.

We look forward to serving you again.

We appreciate your continued support of Coo&RIKU.

The staff were very helpful.
They gave me lots of information over the phone.
It's been 7 days since I got the dog.
I found him online, they sent me pictures, and it took 3 weeks from the time I moved to bring him home. It was delayed by a week because he caught a cold.
It seems they're connected to a hospital.
The dog, who was supposed to be recovered, started sneezing and coughing violently and had trouble breathing, so I took him to a different hospital, where he was diagnosed with kennel cough.
He had the same symptoms, and on the second day after coming home, he also had a fever.
I'm grateful that I was able to buy him, but I'm starting to doubt if everything is really okay.
I've met many different dogs, but the dog bed in the back was terribly dirty and worn out.
I was put off. I think it would be more reassuring if the shop was clean and visible.
The explanation was very kind and easy to understand, so even though it's our first dog, we were able to welcome him into our home with peace of mind! Thank you, Takebayashi-san!
I was anxious about welcoming a pet for the first time, but thanks to the staff, I was able to welcome it with peace of mind.

We welcomed a puppy into our home!

The staff were very polite.

The store didn't have any noticeable smells.

Maybe he could be a little more energetic, haha.

The staff were very kind and explained everything to me, which made me feel at ease!
Thank you very much!

The cutest, well-cared for animals and friendliest staff! They give you every incentive to get proper health insurance and medical care. A special thank you to Sarara Takabayashi for all her help! 💕💕💕 …
It's the best!

I welcomed my dog ​​here.
The staff remembered his name and called him "XX-chan" when he was getting his vaccinations, and several people asked him how he was doing and how big he's gotten, which made me really happy.
Also, when I signed the contract I was asked if I had decided on a name, and when I told them I had already decided, they called him by his name, saying "XX-chan's."
I'm really happy with their consideration.
Cooliku Premium 40 is a great deal and I'm glad I signed up.
Grooming and vaccinations are incredibly cheap.
I look forward to continuing to work with you.

I found a really cute cat here and adopted him last month!
They explained everything to me in detail when I signed the contract ☆
I'd always wanted to have a cat, but I didn't have much knowledge, so I was a little worried, but they told me to let them know if I needed anything, and I'm always there to ask if I have any questions! The staff are all very kind and warm!
I'll be relying on them in the future, so thank you in advance! (*^^*)

I bought a cat. 
The staff looked after the dogs and cats with care and love.

I adopted a Pomapoo from this store a few months ago.

I visited other stores several times, but I just couldn't forget this one...
There were so many plans, and as a first-time pet owner, I had so many questions, but the staff patiently explained everything, which put me at ease.

I was also able to see the dogs and cats' health management up close at different times of the day, and despite hearing only negative reviews online, I realized they are very thorough.

Of course, you can't know everything just by looking, but I think it's wrong to criticize without reason.

The staff who handled my contract and the staff who served me were both cheerful and pleasant.

I recently took my dog ​​to the vet for vaccinations, and they were very affectionate, which made my dog ​​very happy. I'll definitely visit again soon.

The base price was 230,000 yen, but then...

With all the options added, the estimate came to over 500,000 yen!

What's going on?!

While cheaper ones might have issues like abuse or, more recently, being abandoned,

It seemed like a good match, but I've decided to give up on 500,000 yen.

I'd been curious about this cat cafe every time I passed by, so I finally decided to give it a try.

The staff's friendliness and service were impeccable, but as soon as I entered the cat cafe, I was hit with a strange, unpleasant odor. The cat hair hadn't been cleaned up, and I was bothered by the amount of hair flying around from the first step.

The room smelled so bad I could barely breathe, and I got the feeling they hadn't cleaned the litter boxes in a while (I know this from visiting other cat cafes).

I've heard cats are clean animals, so I felt sorry for them.

The water dispenser was supposed to run continuously, but it was almost completely depleted.

The treat service was nice, but then a bullying incident broke out between the cats, and I had to intervene several times to stop it (it wasn't just playful roughhousing, it was outright violence). Perhaps the living conditions are poor and they're stressed...?

The individual cats were all adorable, friendly, and provided wonderful service. Thank you.

There seemed to be no problem with the staff's attitude or anything else, so I just wish they would pay a little more attention to cleaning and hygiene in the cats' customer area. I would like to see those cats again, so please keep that in mind.
A bit small and not have enough products. But in good place

I always use their services for shampooing my dog. All the staff are very polite, and they take excellent care of the puppies and kittens, which speaks to the quality of the store.

I've visited 5 or 6 Coolik stores, and the service varies greatly from store to store. In some places, the staff are constantly chatting instead of taking care of the animals or assisting customers. However, in stores with competent employees, the staff seem to be well-trained.

I feel particularly comfortable leaving my pet at the Shinsaibashi store, so I will continue to use their services as long as the current groomer is there.

There are various reviews, but I think the staff changes depending on when you visit, so I recommend checking each store for yourself before deciding where to buy or leave your pet.
